ces_note: CES optimizer did not converge — landed in Leontief region. Multiplicative loss (0.082) is far below CES loss (0.507), indicating the CES scan missed the rho=0 basin. The 4.1x multiplicative advantage over additive is the reliable finding.
interpretation: Multiplicative form dominates (4.1x lower loss, Spearman 0.945 vs 0.901). Clustering gets NEGATIVE exponent — more clustering hurts synchronizability, consistent with Nishikawa et al. 2003. Efficiency is the dominant driver (exponent 3.4). The multiplicative form with fitted exponents captures network synchronization far better than additive.
